text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Magnificent, Trainer!
It truly is all about how you use a small amount of strength, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I have learned yet another lesson!
A true princess cannot stop at merely crushing macadamia nuts with her bare hands!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Only by having the delicacy to transfer tiny seeds to another plate using chopsticks can one become a truly splendid princess!
